subject: Create Layer 3 Pydantic I/O models
description:
Create `src/mamba_mcp_sap_hana/models/results.py` with Pydantic input/output models for Layer 3 query execution tools.

Models to create:

**Output models:**
- `QueryColumn`: name, data_type
- `ExecuteQueryOutput`: columns (list[QueryColumn]), rows (list[dict]), row_count, has_more (bool), execution_time_ms (float), query_hash (str)
- `PlanOperator`: operator_name, execution_engine, operator_details, subtree_cost (optional)
- `ExplainQueryOutput`: sql, plan (list[PlanOperator]), format ("text" or "json")

**Error models** (shared across all layers):
- `ToolError`: code (str), message (str), suggestion (str | None), context (dict | None), tool_name (str), input_received (dict | None)

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] ExecuteQueryOutput captures all result metadata
- [ ] `has_more` flag indicates truncated results
- [ ] `query_hash` for deduplication/caching
- [ ] ExplainQueryOutput supports both text and JSON format
- [ ] ToolError model matches errors.py factory output

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Empty result set: rows=[], row_count=0, has_more=False
- [ ] Large execution_time_ms values handled correctly

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: Model instantiation with valid query results
• Unit: ToolError model serialization

Source: internal/specs/mamba-mcp-hana-SPEC.md Section 5.3, 9.2
